benefitRows.name: Amazon Prime
benefitRows.description: Get an annual membership of Amazon Prime.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail Amazon Prime membership,spend ₹1.5 lakh within 90 days of card issuance.|Receive an SMS/email with a redemption link from Bank of Baroda.|Log in using your registered mobile number, OTP, and card details.|Get your coupon code and redeem it on the Amazon Prime website.

benefitRows.name: Club Marriott
benefitRows.description: Get an annual membership of Club Marriott.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail your Club Marriott membership, check your email for the activation link and membership number. Download the Club Marriott app, open it, and tap “Activate Membership.” Enter your membership number or registered mobile number, set a 6-digit PIN, and complete activation. Once activated, enjoy exclusive benefits at participating Marriott hotels.
